source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
During Declare Battle Formations, you may place your **ASURYANI MOUNTED** and **VYPER** units in Reserves; each may later arrive using the **Strategic Reserves** arrival rules. Whenever you set up one of your **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** units on the battlefield, count the battle round as 1 higher than it is.

When your opponent's turn ends, you may also move some of your **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** units off the battlefield into [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves), skipping any unit within **Engagement Range** of an enemy unit. How many depends on battle size:

- Incursion: 1 unit at most.
- Strike Force: 2 units at most.
- Onslaught: 3 units at most.

battleRoundForSetup.appliesTo: every setup of a friendly ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit on the battlefield
